recognize_zh: 高倍下右下細胞核呈明顯扭曲、分葉並有凹陷摺痕，細胞質灰藍帶空泡，為前單核球（promonocyte）；左側大細胞核卵圓有線狀摺痕、染色質細緻並見核仁，上方細胞核圓且染色質細緻，符合單核母細胞，屬急性單核球白血病。
features: Large cells with abundant grey-blue cytoplasm and low to moderate N:C ratio
Lower right cell with convoluted, lobulated nucleus showing indentations and folds (promonocyte), with cytoplasmic vacuoles
Left cell with oval nucleus showing a linear nuclear crease, delicate lacy chromatin and a small nucleolus
Upper cell with large round nucleus and finely dispersed chromatin (monoblast-like)
No Auer rods or coarse granules identified
describe_en: High-power view of a peripheral blood smear shows three large immature monocytic cells with abundant grey-blue cytoplasm. The upper cell has a large round nucleus with finely dispersed chromatin, and the left cell has an oval nucleus with a delicate nuclear fold, lacy chromatin and a small nucleolus. The lower right cell has a convoluted, lobulated nucleus with indentations and vacuolated cytoplasm, characteristic of a promonocyte. No Auer rods are identified. Findings are consistent with acute monocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Hypogranular APL cells have bilobed 'butterfly' nuclei with occasional Auer rod bundles, strong MPO positivity and PML::RARA, whereas monocytic cells are NSE positive and MPO weak/negative.
Mature monocytes have more condensed chromatin without nucleoli and less basophilic cytoplasm than promonocytes, which have delicate folded nuclei and fine chromatin.

AMML contains ≥20% neutrophilic lineage cells with MPO-positive myeloblasts in addition to monocytic cells, whereas monoblasts/promonocytes account for ≥80% of leukemic cells in acute monocytic leukemia.
